sections.title: Test Coverage Analysis
sections.content: I verified the truncated snippets against the actual files rather than trusting the cut-offs — most of what looked like gaps in the provided context (`nextActionFor`, `deriveDesignation`, `hasSource`, `displayWho`, `resolveKindColors`, `usePrefersReducedMotion`, `signalPreview/CleanBody/HasRaw`, `fmtMedian`, `toneForRisk`, `incidentTraceRef`) turned out to already be well-covered — those were just where the excerpt got cut, not real gaps. Three real gaps survived verification.

sections.title: 1. `RoutingTable.tsx` — zero test coverage (confirmed)
2. `ResearchActivity.test.ts` — DOM rendering block is disabled (confirmed, not just truncated)
3. Ink component library — 11 of 17 components have no test file
Integration test gap (adjacent, not fixed by any unit test above)
sections.content: `RoutingPolicyBar` + `RoutingTable` are siblings under `/routing-console` but there's no test exercising them together against `routing-console.functions.ts` — a policy change (`auto-adopt` → `hold`) should freeze row mutation, and that cross-component contract is currently unverified at any level.
